comparatorRouteSelection.basis: The University of Groningen regulation distinguishes Dutch Language and Culture and Frisian Language and Culture. The normalized registry target itself names Dutch Language and Culture, so this formal route is selected before and independently of evaluating any UCR course fit. The route's genuine 30-EC minor remains open rather than being populated with an invented specialization.

audience.programmeDescription: Students study Dutch literature from the Middle Ages to the present and examine the structure, history and use of Dutch. They apply these methods in research workshops and a thesis.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The closest UCR combination studies how texts create meaning and how people argue, write and use language, combining literary interpretation, stylistics, rhetoric and psycholinguistics. Groningen develops those subjects specifically through Dutch literary history, language structure and advanced use of Dutch.

componentNotes.y2-06: Complete workshops in two different areas chosen from literature, linguistics and language use.
componentNotes.thesis: Before starting, complete at least 50 EC from year one, earn at least 100 EC in the degree overall, and pass Research Approaches.
